她受邀擔任學校寫作比賽的評審。
Regular exercise is a preventative measure against many diseases.
規律運動是預防許多疾病的措施。
The city took preventative steps before the typhoon arrived.
颱風來襲前，市政府採取了預防措施。
Vaccines are the best preventative against the flu.
疫苗是預防流感的最佳方法。
Garlic is sometimes used as a preventative for colds.
大蒜有時被當作預防感冒的東西。
He unhooked the leash and let the dog run free.
他解開牽繩的扣環，讓狗自由奔跑。
Can you unhook my necklace? I can't reach the clasp.
你可以幫我解開項鍊嗎？我搆不到扣環。
She worked feverishly to finish the report before midnight.
她拚命趕工，想在午夜前完成報告。
The students searched feverishly for their missing keys.
學生們慌忙地尋找不見的鑰匙。

crossed.zh: 越過；穿越（cross 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: We crossed the river on a small wooden bridge.
我們走過一座小木橋渡過河。
The idea never crossed my mind until yesterday.
直到昨天我才想到這個點子。
She sat with her arms crossed and said nothing.
她雙臂交叉坐著，什麼也沒說。
He tapped his foot with his legs crossed under the table.
他把腿在桌下交叉，腳還一邊打著拍子。
The walls of our new apartment are painted light blue.
我們新公寓的牆壁漆成了淡藍色。
Tourists can walk along the old city walls.
遊客可以沿著古老的城牆散步。
Massed crowds filled the square to watch the parade.
聚集的人群擠滿廣場觀看遊行。
The massed choir sang together in the large hall.
合唱團成員齊聚一堂，在大廳裡一起歌唱。
The old king decided to abdicate in favor of his son.
年老的國王決定退位，把王位讓給兒子。
Parents should not abdicate their responsibility for their children.
父母不應該放棄對孩子的責任。
The bank can repossess your car if you stop paying the loan.
如果你不再繳貸款，銀行可以收回你的車。
The shop repossessed the sofa after he missed three payments.
他三期沒繳款之後，商店把沙發收了回去。
Their firstborn is now ten years old.
他們的第一個孩子現在十歲了。
In the story, the king's firstborn inherits the throne.
故事中，國王的長子繼承王位。
Their firstborn son was named after his grandfather.
他們的長子以祖父的名字命名。
The firstborn child often gets the most attention from parents.
第一個出生的孩子常常得到父母最多的關注。
The writer received a posthumous award for her last book.
這位作家因她的最後一本書獲得了追贈的獎項。
His posthumous fame was greater than anything he knew in life.
他死後的名聲遠超過他生前所知的一切。
The study used a randomized trial to test the new medicine.
這項研究採用隨機試驗來測試新藥。
The teacher gave each student a randomized list of questions.
老師給每位學生一份隨機排序的題目。

appallingly.zh: 令人震驚地；糟糕透頂地
ai: The food at that restaurant was appallingly bad.
那家餐廳的食物難吃得讓人震驚。
The roads are appallingly dangerous after heavy rain.
大雨過後，這些路危險得嚇人。
Please send a short synopsis of your story.
請寄一份你故事的簡短大綱。
I read the film's synopsis online before buying tickets.
買票前我在網路上看了這部電影的劇情簡介。
Some students began to snicker when the teacher tripped.
老師絆倒時，有些學生開始竊笑。
He tried not to snicker at his friend's silly hat.
他努力不去偷笑朋友那頂傻氣的帽子。
I heard a snicker from the back of the classroom.
我聽到教室後面傳來一聲竊笑。
His joke got a snicker from the crowd.
他的笑話引來人群中的一陣竊笑。
Your argument is not tenable, because the numbers don't match.
你的論點站不住腳，因為數字對不上。
It is hard to say that this position is still tenable.
很難說這個立場還站得住腳。
The river used to teem with fish.
這條河以前到處都是魚。
The market was teeming with shoppers on Saturday.
星期六的市場擠滿了購物的人。
The film follows the amorous adventures of a young painter.
這部電影描寫一位年輕畫家的愛情冒險。
He sent her amorous letters during the long summer.
漫長的夏天裡，他寄給她許多情意綿綿的信。
The schoolday ends at three thirty in the afternoon.
上學日在下午三點半結束。
He remembers his schooldays as the happiest time of his life.
他記得學生時代是他一生中最快樂的時光。
She wore a bright yellow poncho to stay dry in the rain.
她穿著鮮黃色的雨披在雨中保持乾燥。
He bought a woolen poncho at the market in the mountains.
他在山區的市集買了一件羊毛披風。
The mother sang softly to pacify the crying baby.
母親輕聲唱歌來安撫哭鬧的寶寶。
The manager tried to pacify the angry customers with a free coffee.
經理試著用一杯免費咖啡來安撫憤怒的顧客。
This is the furthest I have ever walked in one day.
這是我一天內走過最遠的一次。
The furthest star we can see with our eyes is very far away.
我們用肉眼能看到的最遠的星星，距離非常遙遠。
Who can throw the ball furthest?
誰能把球丟得最遠？
Of all of us, Mia traveled furthest to attend the wedding.
我們所有人當中，米雅為了參加婚禮走了最遠的路。
We have a fortnightly meeting on Thursday mornings.
我們每兩週的星期四早上開一次會。
The magazine is published as a fortnightly review.
這份雜誌每兩週出刊一次。
The cleaners come fortnightly to tidy the office.
清潔人員每兩週來整理一次辦公室。
The club meets fortnightly in the library.
這個社團每兩週在圖書館聚會一次。
He is a big spender who loves buying gifts for friends.
他花錢很大方，喜歡買禮物送朋友。
As a careful spender, she always compares prices first.
身為精打細算的人，她總是先比價。
The movie ended disappointingly, and we left feeling sad.
這部電影的結局令人失望，我們離開時心情很低落。
Sales were disappointingly low during the holiday season.
假期期間的銷售量低得令人失望。
She was vexed that nobody had called her back.
沒有人回她電話，讓她很惱火。
The vexed question of who should pay is still not settled.
到底該由誰付錢這個棘手的問題還沒解決。
They opened an upmarket restaurant in the center of town.
他們在市中心開了一家高檔餐廳。
The brand is trying to move upmarket and attract richer customers.
這個品牌想往高檔市場發展，吸引更有錢的顧客。
The old bridge was declared structurally unsound.
那座舊橋被判定在結構上不安全。
His plan was based on unsound reasoning.
他的計畫是建立在站不住腳的推論上。
The children watched in awed silence as the whale appeared.
鯨魚出現時，孩子們敬畏地安靜看著。
She felt awed by the size of the ancient temple.
她被古老神殿的規模震懾住了。
He gave her a watch inscribed with her initials.
他送給她一只刻有她姓名縮寫的手錶。
The stone was inscribed with a short poem.
那塊石頭上刻著一首短詩。
The kids played in the sandbox for the whole afternoon.
孩子們整個下午都在沙坑裡玩。
Dad built a small sandbox in the backyard.
爸爸在後院蓋了一個小沙坑。
Developers test new code in a sandbox before releasing it.
開發人員在正式發布前會先在沙盒中測試新程式碼。
The browser runs each tab in its own sandbox for safety.
瀏覽器為了安全，讓每個分頁都在各自的沙盒中執行。
He felt panicky when he couldn't find his passport.
他找不到護照時覺得很慌張。
The panicky crowd rushed toward the exit.
驚慌的群眾衝向出口。
The view from the mountain top was stupendous.
從山頂望出去的景色令人驚嘆。
They built the stadium at a stupendous cost.
他們蓋這座體育場花費了驚人的成本。
She put her foot in the stirrup and climbed onto the horse.
她把腳踩進馬鐙，爬上了馬。
The rider's boot slipped out of the stirrup.
騎士的靴子從馬鐙中滑了出來。
There was only a light sprinkling of snow on the ground.
地上只有薄薄一層零星的雪。
The salad had a sprinkling of nuts on top.
沙拉上面撒了少許堅果。
His sudden announcement did dumbfound the whole family.
他突然的宣布讓全家人都驚呆了。
The magician's last trick is sure to dumbfound the audience.
魔術師的最後一個把戲一定會讓觀眾目瞪口呆。
I fell asleep to the patter of rain on the roof.
我聽著雨點輕拍屋頂的聲音睡著了。
We heard the patter of small feet running down the hall.
我們聽到小腳丫在走廊上快步跑過的啪嗒聲。
Rain began to patter against the window.
雨開始啪嗒啪嗒地打在窗戶上。
The puppy pattered across the kitchen floor.
小狗啪嗒啪嗒地跑過廚房地板。
She washed the glassware by hand to avoid breaking it.
她用手洗玻璃器皿，以免打破。
The shop sells beautiful glassware for the dining table.
這家店賣很漂亮的餐桌玻璃器皿。

kitsch.zh: 媚俗的東西；庸俗藝術品
ai: The gift shop was full of cheap kitsch for tourists.
那家紀念品店裡擺滿了給觀光客的廉價媚俗小物。
Some people love kitsch, while others find it ugly.
有些人喜歡媚俗的玩意兒，有些人則覺得很醜。
He became an apologist for the company's new policy.
他成了公司新政策的辯護者。
The writer is often seen as an apologist for the old system.
這位作家常被視為舊制度的辯護人。
Scaling the photo down will make the file smaller.
把照片縮小可以讓檔案變小。
The startup is focused on scaling its service to more cities.
這家新創公司專注於把服務擴展到更多城市。
The scaling of the cliff took the climbers three hours.
攀登那面峭壁花了登山者三個小時。
Scaling the high wall without a rope was impossible.
沒有繩子就要爬上那面高牆是不可能的。
The climactic scene of the film made everyone gasp.
這部電影的高潮場景讓每個人都倒抽一口氣。
The climactic battle takes place in the last chapter.
最高潮的那場戰鬥發生在最後一章。

fluttering.zh: 拍動；飄動（flutter 的現在分詞）
ai: Flags were fluttering in the wind along the street.
街道兩旁的旗子在風中飄動。
A butterfly was fluttering around the flowers.
一隻蝴蝶在花叢旁翩翩飛舞。
My heart was fluttering as I walked onto the stage.
我走上舞台時，心跳得怦怦亂跳。
The interviewer was a patient interlocutor who let her guest finish speaking.
訪問者是個有耐心的對談者，讓來賓把話說完。
In class, we practice with an interlocutor to improve our speaking.
在課堂上，我們和對話夥伴一起練習以提升口說能力。
The baby took a few faltering steps toward her mother.
寶寶搖搖晃晃地朝媽媽走了幾步。
He answered in a faltering voice, clearly nervous.
他用顫抖遲疑的聲音回答，顯然很緊張。

contained.zh: 包含；含有（contain 的過去式）
ai: The box contained old photos and letters.
盒子裡裝著舊照片和信件。
The report contained several mistakes.
這份報告含有好幾個錯誤。

contained.zh: 控制住；遏制（contain 的過去式）
ai: Firefighters contained the fire before it reached the houses.
消防員在火勢蔓延到住家之前就把火控制住了。
She barely contained her excitement during the ceremony.
典禮進行時，她幾乎壓不住心中的興奮。
I like my tea unsweetened.
我喜歡喝不加糖的茶。
She bought unsweetened soy milk at the store.
她在店裡買了無糖豆漿。
The two families had a vendetta that lasted for generations.
這兩個家族的世仇延續了好幾代。
He felt the boss had a personal vendetta against him.
他覺得老闆對他懷有私人恩怨。
The villain in the story has a nefarious plan to take over the city.
故事裡的壞人有個奪取整座城市的邪惡計畫。
The police uncovered a nefarious scheme to cheat old people.
警方查出了一個欺騙老人的惡劣陰謀。
She rose to eminence as a scientist in her field.
她在自己的領域中成為享有盛名的科學家。
The professor's eminence made him popular as a guest speaker.
這位教授的崇高名望讓他很受邀請當客座講者。

inferno.zh: 大火；烈火地獄般的地方
ai: Within minutes the old warehouse became a raging inferno.
短短幾分鐘內，那座舊倉庫就變成一片熊熊烈火。
The kitchen was an inferno on the busiest night of the year.
在一年中最忙的那個晚上，廚房熱得像地獄。
We camped downwind of the fire so the smoke blew away from us.
我們在營火的下風處紮營，這樣煙就會往別處吹。
The sailors drifted downwind toward the island.
水手們順著風向飄向那座島。
The farm lies in the downwind direction from the factory.
這座農場位在工廠的下風處。
Residents downwind of the fire were told to stay indoors.
火場下風處的居民被告知要待在室內。
Many young voters feel a deep disenchantment with politics.
許多年輕選民對政治感到深深的幻滅。
His disenchantment with the job grew after the third year.
工作到第三年後，他對這份工作的幻滅感越來越深。
Herders on the steppe move with their sheep across wide grasslands.
大草原上的牧人帶著羊群穿越遼闊的草地遷移。
The train crossed the endless steppe for hours.
火車在無邊無際的大草原上行駛了好幾個小時。

debating.zh: 辯論；爭論（debate 的現在分詞）
ai: The students are debating whether school should start later.
學生們正在辯論學校是不是應該晚一點上課。
We were debating where to eat when it began to rain.
我們正在討論要去哪裡吃飯時，下起雨來了。
The old wall served as a bulwark against enemy attacks.
那道古牆曾是抵擋敵人進攻的屏障。
A free press is a bulwark of democracy.
新聞自由是民主的重要保障。
Many people said the decision was undemocratic.
許多人說這項決定不民主。
The club has an undemocratic system where only one person decides everything.
這個社團的制度不民主，所有事情只由一個人決定。
The mailman puts the letters in our box every morning.
郵差每天早上把信放進我們的信箱。
Our dog barks every time the mailman comes to the gate.
每次郵差來到門口，我們的狗都會叫。
He was hurt by his uncaring father.
他被漠不關心的父親傷了心。
The company seemed cold and uncaring toward its workers.
這家公司對員工似乎冷漠又不關心。

echoing.zh: 發出回音（echo 的現在分詞）
ai: Our footsteps were echoing in the empty hall.
我們的腳步聲在空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴響。
Her voice kept echoing through the canyon.
她的聲音在峽谷裡不斷迴盪。

echoing.zh: 附和；重複（echo 的現在分詞）
ai: He kept echoing everything his boss said.
他不停地重複老闆說的每一句話。
Echoing her friend's opinion, she said the idea was great.
她附和朋友的意見，說這個點子很棒。

stalking.zh: 跟蹤；悄悄逼近（stalk 的現在分詞）
ai: The cat was stalking a bird in the garden.
貓正在花園裡悄悄逼近一隻鳥。
The police arrested a man for stalking his former classmate.
警方逮捕了一名跟蹤前同學的男子。
The bus runs irregularly on weekends.
這路公車在週末的班次不固定。
He sleeps irregularly, sometimes at noon and sometimes at night.
他的睡眠很不規律，有時中午睡，有時晚上睡。
Some people think the laws of nature are immutable.
有些人認為自然法則是不可改變的。
The password is stored in an immutable record that nobody can edit.
密碼存放在一筆誰也無法修改的記錄裡。
The fight started at the instigation of a few older boys.
這場打鬥是在幾個大男孩的煽動下開始的。
She did it at her brother's instigation.
她是在哥哥的唆使下做這件事的。
We had a cloudless sky all week during our trip.
我們旅行的那一整個星期都是萬里無雲的晴天。
The stars were bright on the cloudless night.
在無雲的夜晚，星星特別明亮。
The king wore his full regalia for the coronation.
國王在加冕典禮上穿戴了完整的王室禮服與徽飾。
Graduates in academic regalia lined up for photos.
身穿學位禮服的畢業生排隊拍照。
Let's take a breather before we climb the next hill.
爬下一座山丘前，我們先休息一下吧。
After the long meeting, she stepped outside for a breather.
開完冗長的會議，她走到外面喘口氣。

swearing.zh: 罵髒話（swear 的現在分詞）
ai: The coach was angry at the players for swearing during practice.
教練對球員在練習中說髒話感到很生氣。
Stop swearing in front of the children.
別在孩子面前罵髒話。
He stood in court swearing to tell the truth.
他站在法庭上宣誓會說實話。
She kept swearing that she had locked the door.
她一直發誓說自己有鎖門。
